Question 3
?

Find the Laplace transform of y(t), if y″+y′−2y=u2(t),y(0)=0,y′(0)=1, where u2(t)=u(t−2) is the unit step function.

a
 Y(s)=e−2s+s(s+2)2(s−1)
b
 Y(s)=e−2ss(s−1)2
c
 Y(s)=e−2s(s+2)(s−1)
d
 Y(s)=e−2s+ss(s+2)
e
 Y(s)=e−2s+ss(s+2)(s−1)
Submit
